objective: Replace unsafe data assembly with fully traceable chronological learning datasets.
deliverable_refs: DatasetManifest/row lineage, SplitManifest, cutoff-scoped export and deduplication.
Walk-forward train/development/qualification, purge and embargo implementation.
Per-fold transforms/index construction and sample-weight handling.
required_test_refs: Label dependency intervals crossing folds are removed; all same-session rows stay together.
Training-only fit and mature-only release tested through actual pipeline integration.
acceptance_gate: Each dataset row and learned dependency can be traced to legal inputs and a verified fold assignment.
